statement: The 5 single mutants with the highest MEASURED fitness (ProteinGym SDA_BACSU_Tsuboyama_2023_1PV0, E3) are S12T, S12V, S12A, I41L, T17V, in that order.

ESM-2 masked-marginal E1 scores rank mutants only weakly and are NOT additive over simultaneous mutations (batch 3-mutation test differed from the sum by 0.037), so all scores were computed individually.

High E1 score alone is insufficient: N22E (E1 +1.40), G39N (+1.24), F14I (+1.17), H40Q (+0.63), H40R (+0.92) all measured NEGATIVE. Conservative substitutions at mutation-tolerant positions were the reliable signal.
Position 12 is the dominant high-fitness locus: S->T (+0.513), S->V (+0.484), S->A (+0.467). Position 41 (I41L +0.313) and 17 (T17V +0.289) also high.

LIMITATIONS: only 24 of 834 candidates were measured and all were queried high-E1-first, so the true top-quartile threshold was never estimated from an unbiased sample; unmeasured candidates (810) are UNOBSERVED. E1 values are model predictions (E1), never measurements.
